subject: Delay and priorities update
text: Hi everyone, sorry this is arriving so close to Sunday, and I know we promised the route map on Friday, but the delay is messier than the first text showed. The main issue is the permit desk reopened for corrections, so the access letter is now pending until Thursday, unless we use the smaller north lot, with no toilets and one drop-off point. I re-read the email, requirements shifted, and another group flagged rain concerns on the path, so I paused the volunteer list to check drainage before putting people at that spot. I also realized the speaker system plan was overkill for twelve chairs, and it took me longer than I care to admit to ask the café whether we can borrow one. That is the change in priorities: right now the safe route and basic sound matter more than the banner and certificate moment, and I would rather scale back than rush. The flyers are still fine, though the times may move by fifteen minutes, so do not print yet unless you did. If anyone can share a picture of the north lot, that would help, or if you have a simple battery speaker please let us know, no fancy ones, just one that does not crackle. I will send another update tomorrow morning, probably before my first coffee, and I will try not to sound as scattered as this email. Sorry again for the late notice, and thank you for being patient while the details keep wobbling.
